remarks: Custom built and well-maintained Ranch located in the "Old Hill" section of town, just minutes to Downtown Westport & Saugatuck dining and shopping, Route 1, Whole Foods, Stew Leonard's, I-95, the Merritt Parkway and Metro North. Large open living room/dining room combo with fireplace, flows directly into the bright and sunny kitchen/family room combo with second fireplace and sliders to the rear stone patio, making entertaining a breeze. The Primary bedroom suite is handicap accessible with a large bathroom with an open shower concept, dressing room and rear sliders to the patio as well. Three additional bedrooms, full hall bath with double vanity, laundry area, half bath and two car garage complete this floor. In the lower level, you will find a large playroom, 5th bedroom (or office) and full bath with built-in sauna. Tons of additional storage space in the unfinished portion of the lower level with room to expand. With over 3,500 sqft of finished living space and many updates throughout the years... This home and neighborhood are bound to steal many hearts. Don't miss your opportunity. Set up an appointment to preview today! (Estate Sale - Subject to Probate)
